The '''Imperial Database''' was an informational system of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. It contained listings of affiliations of specific organizations within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] belonged to, their rank, their training certificates for various Imperial vehicles (including the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]], the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], and the [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]]), [[Medal (disambiguation)|Medals]] that the Imperial personnel won as well as embellishments for other actions taken during various battles, as well as their battle records.

{{Imp-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Database was the results screen for the game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] as well as its expansion packs. It acted as the equivalent to the Farlander Uniform screen from [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']].
